The frontend module `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` defines the memo CRUD mutations/queries (`useMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, `useMemoComments`, etc.). It calls these through `memoServiceClient`, which is created in `web/src/connect.ts` (`export const memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport);`) using the generated `MemoService` client from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`.

Answer: `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`; `memoServiceClient` (generated `MemoService` Connect client, instantiated in `web/src/connect.ts` from `web/src/types/proto/api/v1/memo_service_pb.ts`)
